segments.name: U.S. Digital
segments.description: Aggregates U.S. eCommerce, Outfitters and Third Party operations selling Lands' End apparel and uniforms to U.S. consumers, businesses and schools.
segments.evidence: the results of these operating segments are aggregated into one external reportable segment, the U.S. Digital segment.

revenueModel.text: Consumers, businesses and schools pay Lands' End for apparel and uniforms sold through its eCommerce website, third-party marketplaces and Company Operated stores, while licensees pay royalties and fulfillment fees.
revenueModel.evidence: Licensing earns royalties on the use of Lands' End trademark and fees for fulfillment services provided by the Company.
